'''Putrid zombies''' are [[monster]]s summoned during the fight with [[Rasial, the First Necromancer]]. Two of them also attack the player with [[Hermod, the Spirit of War]] during [[Alpha vs Omega]].

When summoned by Rasial, the First Necromancer during [[Alpha vs Omega]], their [[life points]] are halved.
